posts.author: Xipinjin
posts.body:
Hello,
I am currently working on a RPG Maker MV game where I want to implement a grid based inventory system where items are represented by blocks of different shapes and the player has to organize them to optimize the capacity of the inventory (like in Resident Evil or Dredge).
I've found plugins for grid based inventories but nothing close to the shape blocks thing so if you know a plugin to make it work or with a script or just an advice, it would be much appreciated!
Thanks!
